Senses.Explanation: To make the formal greeting is to perform the conventional monastic salutation and inquiry after another’s well-being. The monastic rules prescribe it during travel and arrival; Linji Yixuan and Fayan Wenyi then make the greeting’s timing part of encounters, and the Asvaghosa story records the same visible act. It is more specific than any casual question.
